sources.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / downward outpainting. Input is the clean Zombie Road farm arena WITHOUT a house. EXTEND THE CANVAS DOWNWARD ONLY: new portrait aspect ratio 4:7, ideally 1024x1792 instead of 1024x1536. Preserve the original arena in the TOP 1024x1536 region as closely as possible: shallow cornfield top, broad dirt combat clearing, free side lanes and all original lighting/texture. The bottom of the original region is y=1536. In the NEW ADDED BOTTOM REGION y=1536..1792, add a charming small AMERICAN FARMHOUSE centered below the future pickup truck, separated from that truck by a short driveway. This is crucial: EVERY part of the house including roof and chimney starts BELOW y=1540; no roof enters the original battle arena. Show a compact one-story white weathered clapboard farmhouse/ranch home, red-brown shingle gable roof, covered wooden porch with posts, front door and warm lit windows facing UP/north toward the arena. House about 45%-50% of canvas width, front porch near the bottom edge, scale coherent with the farm. Detailed hand-crafted pixel art, same overhead orthographic RPG camera and golden evening light. Low shrubs frame only the bottom corners. Leave the original lower clearing around x=35%-65%, y=1350..1535 unobstructed for a SEPARATE defensive pickup and sandbag layer that will be drawn by the game. The separate truck will be IN FRONT of the house, above it on screen; there must be actual spacing between them, not a truck drawn on a roof. DO NOT DRAW any truck, sandbags, actors, UI, labels or text. Deliver a visibly TALLER 4:7 image, preserving original gameplay area and adding ONLY a bottom homestead backdrop. Do not compress the arena or move the house up to fit the old canvas.

previousVersions.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached approved Zombie Road farm scene. Create the CLEAN ENVIRONMENT LAYER for the game from this scene, preserving its exact detailed pixel art style, earthy colors, warm late afternoon lighting, barn, trees, crops and worn farm props. Keep portrait 2:3 composition and the same high-angle orthographic RPG camera. Remove ALL living actors: every zombie, the female defender, sheriff, dog and chicken; also remove ALL sandbags, the entire pickup truck, the mounted gun, ammunition crates and all defensive base equipment from the bottom. Reconstruct natural empty dirt and sparse grass beneath the removed objects. The bottom 20% must now be open flat ground onto which a separate transparent defensive base can later be overlaid. Keep the broad middle battle corridor empty and low-contrast, with coherent ground texture; reduce any large obstacles intruding into it. Rich environmental detail should live on the perimeter and north/barn edge. Preserve the approved handcrafted pixel texture and material depth. No actors, no silhouettes, no baked-in health bars, no UI, no text, no grids, no additional building in the central corridor. This is a playable clean background, not a populated illustration.
previousVersions.note: Cenário anterior com celeiro, preservado antes da edição solicitada.

previousVersions.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY the NORTH/TOP portion of this existing approved Zombie Road game background. Replace the entire red barn, ALL its roofs, silo, windmill and barn-associated north-edge structures with a CORNFIELD from which zombies can emerge. Keep the exact portrait 1024x1536 canvas, same detailed pixel-art style, earthy colors, golden late-afternoon lighting and overhead orthographic RPG camera. Cornfield design: tall dense green and golden corn extending beyond the TOP edge and spanning the whole north width, with an irregular front edge and several narrow broken openings between stalks across the middle 80 percent of the width. The actual zombie spawn positions are spread across x=10% through x=90% at the top, so do NOT funnel everything into a single central doorway. Keep the main solid corn band shallow: approximately top 10% of image height; it should transition through scattered stalks and trampled soil to OPEN combat ground by y=15% of image height. No barn, roof, building, wall, silo or raised platform anywhere in the upper spawn area. The effect must read as creatures coming out of crops into the arena, not walking over a building. Preserve ALL the rest of the image below the top 22 percent as closely as possible: identical ground, side trees/crops, rustic edge equipment, lamps, bottom gate, dirt clearing, open lower ground for the separate base. No characters, zombies, animals, base, truck, UI, text or grid. Keep this a clean environment layer, and do not paint any sprites or health bars.
previousVersions.note: Milharal com decoração lateral densa, preservado antes de ampliar a clareira.

previousVersions.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached Zombie Road farm arena to FIX SIDE OBSTACLES conflicting with gameplay. Preserve the approved detailed pixel art, exact 1024x1536 portrait canvas, warm golden lighting, color palette, north CORNFIELD with multiple exits, and open ground for the separate defensive base. Make a substantially WIDER dirt clearing; this is important, not a subtle cleanup. The playable band from y=15% to y=88% of image height must be walkable flat terrain essentially edge-to-edge. Remove all tall side trees AND their canopies, stacked crates, wheelbarrow, barrels, raised water tank/tower, tires, timber, brick walls, buildings, lamps/posts, and tall side corn rows throughout this middle band. Reconstruct coherent worn dirt under removed objects. Dirt should span approximately x=3% to x=97%; the outermost 3% on either side may have FLAT short grass, tiny weeds or small stones only, no solid obstacles, large bushes, trunks or overhanging canopy. Do not merely shrink the existing props while leaving them in the combat area. Concentrate rich raised props and foliage ONLY in the bottommost 10% of the image (below the defense line), and preserve the top shallow cornfield so enemies still come from the corn. Keep the clearing visually interesting with subtle trampled earth, wheel ruts, small patches of short grass, soil color variations and a few tiny pebbles, all visibly WALKABLE, no grids. Keep the lower central area empty to overlay the truck/base. No zombies, characters, animals, truck, base, UI, labels or text. The goal is a broad farm battle arena where sprites at x=5% and x=95% walk on clear ground instead of appearing on top of trees or crates. Same camera, same art quality; only redistribute/remove the environmental detail to respect this walkable area.

The farmhouse is currently too large and too high. SCALE THE ENTIRE HOUSE INCLUDING ROOF, CHIMNEY, PORCH AND STEPS TO 65% OF ITS CURRENT SIZE. Move this smaller house DOWN, centered at x=474. The full smaller house will be about 320 pixels wide and about 200 pixels tall. Keep its exact American white wooden farmhouse design, gabled red roof, warm windows and porch. Restore matching bare dirt at the OLD house location y=1240..1449 so the area above the small house becomes a clear driveway. This empty driveway is REQUIRED for a separate pickup layer; no house pixel may be above y=1450. All original corn and upper arena stay unchanged. Keep the FULL small house visible near the bottom; do NOT enlarge it to fill the image. No truck, sandbags, actors, UI or text.

sources.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target/reference: approved Zombie Road farm scene. Extract and redesign its defensive base as ONE transparent PNG sprite atlas with FOUR distinct damage states in an EXACT 2 columns by 2 rows grid of equal SQUARE cells on a square canvas. Match the approved detailed pixel art, rust-orange pickup truck, metal textures, warm left sunlight and plum shadows. Each cell: a horizontal tan sandbag wall spanning the full cell width at 78 percent of cell height, and a SMALL pickup with mounted machine gun centered immediately below that wall; nothing may cross cell boundaries. The pickup faces NORTH/up-screen with hood pointing toward wall, seen from the same high overhead orthographic RPG camera: visible roof, hood and rear bed, NO side-on truck. Empty transparent top 76 percent of EACH cell. Truck and wall fit in BOTTOM 24 percent of each cell. All four states have IDENTICAL geometry, position and size, all on genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background, no opaque ground, no checkerboard drawn, no labels, no borders, no text. Grid order: top-left intact, top-right lightly damaged, bottom-left heavy dents and cracked windshield, bottom-right disabled with a small dark smoke wisp and broken hood, no big flames. Preserve the same recognizable vehicle in every cell. No actors or environment scenery. This exact 2x2 atlas and consistent registration will be sliced by the game.

Create a runtime prototype SPRITE ATLAS, not a character illustration. Output a WIDE landscape transparent PNG, ideally 1536 by 576, with EXACTLY 8 columns and 3 rows of equal cells. Each row contains the SAME character in all 8 columns, never different people. Row 1 faces DOWN toward viewer; row 2 faces UP away from viewer; row 3 is full RIGHT-facing profile. Columns left to right: 0 relaxed standing, 1 walking left foot forward, 2 walking passing pose, 3 walking right foot forward, 4 attack anticipation, 5 attack impact, 6 attack recovery, 7 dead lying sideways on ground. Every sprite fits fully within its cell with at least 8 percent transparent gutters. Consistent character scale in ALL standing, walking and attack cells; soles aligned at 93 percent of each cell height. Cell 7 corpse lies near that same floor baseline. Exactly 24 visible sprites, no extras, no text, no grid lines, no panel backgrounds, no checkerboard painted, no cast shadows outside cell, genuinely transparent alpha. Match the detailed pixel-art material definition, hand-crafted pixel clusters and warm highlights of the approved farm scene, NOT smooth vector cartoon. Same orthographic RPG view as its actors, with visible top of head and shoulders. Keep face/outfit recognizable at a small mobile-game size. No gigantic head, no cropped feet, no weapon crossing into next cell. Reference image 1 is the identity reference: Mira, a brown-haired young female rifle defender with green hooded jacket, gray dark trousers, brown boots and long steel rifle. Preserve these colors and identity, but use more natural compact RPG proportions and detailed jacket folds and hair highlights. Reference image 2 is the approved style/lighting reference only. In attack anticipation/impact/recovery Mira shoulders and fires her rifle in the row's facing direction. Avoid giant muzzle flashes, only a very small flash in column 5. Back row must show the BACK of her head and green hood; no face looking at viewer.
sources.refinementPrompt: Use case: background-extraction. Precise edit of this existing 8-column by 3-row sprite atlas ONLY. Preserve ALL 24 characters, exact sprite positions, dimensions, cell layout, pixel colors and poses, and the full 2048x768 wide canvas. Remove ALL brown background, ALL warm atmospheric glow/halos, ALL gradients and shadows BETWEEN the characters and under their feet, leaving truly transparent empty pixels around each separate sprite. Characters themselves must have fully opaque interiors and crisp cutout alpha edges. Keep only the tiny rifle muzzle flash belonging to a firing pose, no broad glow. Do NOT move, resize, repaint or add any characters. Do NOT draw a background, checkerboard, border, labels or grid. Deliver the same exact atlas as a clean transparent PNG ready for game compositing. The brown haze is unwanted and must be completely absent. Restore transparent padding between cells while preserving every foot and rifle.
